systems.country_label: réseau de télécommunications destiné aux collectivités territoriales
systems.owner: AGEFAU; the involvement of SMTD SA was a subject of the meeting
systems.tiers: collectivités territoriales, as the network's stated destination; no office said to be on it

note: The page reports a meeting of 15 April 2025 between the acting director general of AGEFAU and the director general of SMTD, whose subjects included SMTD's involvement in the project for a telecommunications network for the collectivités territoriales and the reactivation of a convention signed in September 2022. It states that the project exists and nothing about what the network does, who is on it or its progress.
